acquisition.interface: wikidot.py Page metadata populated by the live ListPages response
acquisition.timestamp_semantics: The pinned wikidot.py parser returns naive datetime values whose source Unix timestamps are UTC.

analysis: Live Wikidot exposes a structured identity tuple for each populated lifecycle user: numeric Wikidot user ID, display name, and unix name.

At initial capture, the frozen SCP corpus metadata retained only the display-name string for created_by, updated_by, and commented_by. The loss occurred in the corpus adapter, which stringified the user object even though the local wikidot.py object retained all three identity fields.

The producer now preserves the additive structured identity fields, and the refreshed scp-3435 corpus record carries all three live tuples. Wikijump consumes those fields without substituting the local importer account.
